repos.description: Updated list of public BitTorrent trackers
repos.summary_zh: 提供每日自动更新的公共 BitTorrent tracker 列表，涵盖 UDP、HTTP、HTTPS、WebSocket、i2p 和 Yggdrasil 等多种协议。包含域名与 IP 两种格式，通过自动化检测去重，优化 P2P 文件共享的连接效率与稳定性，适用于 BT 客户端配置及去中心化网络应用场景。
repos.summary_en: Daily automatically updated public BitTorrent tracker lists supporting multiple protocols including UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket, i2p and Yggdrasil. Provides both domain and IP address formats, with automated deduplication to optimize P2P file sharing connectivity and stability for BT clients and decentralized network applications.

repos.description: The most intuitive desktop API client. Organize and execute REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, Server Sent Events, and gRPC 🦬
repos.summary_zh: Yaak 是一款隐私优先的跨平台桌面 API 客户端，全面支持 REST、GraphQL、WebSocket、SSE 和 gRPC 协议。基于 Tauri 框架构建，后端采用 Rust 实现高性能与安全性，前端使用 React 提供流畅交互。通过社区许可模式运营，为开发者提供直观、高效的 API 调试与管理解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Yaak is a privacy-first cross-platform desktop API client supporting REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, SSE, and gRPC protocols. Built on Tauri framework with Rust backend and React frontend, it delivers high-performance API debugging experience. Community-funded through license purchases, it offers intuitive interface for developers to organize, test, and manage APIs efficiently.

repos.description: Simple Proxy Client to force proxy to any Windows/MacOS/Linux Application TCP and UDP traffic
repos.summary_zh: ProxyBridge是轻量开源跨平台代理客户端（Proxifier替代品），支持Windows、macOS、Linux。它在系统层透明拦截指定进程的TCP/UDP流量，通过SOCKS5或HTTP代理路由、阻止或放行，无需修改应用配置，兼容无代理感知程序，适用于安全测试、流量分析及协议调试。
repos.summary_en: ProxyBridge is a lightweight open-source cross-platform proxy client (Proxifier alternative) for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It transparently redirects TCP/UDP traffic from specific processes through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies at the system level, supporting per-app routing, blocking, or allowing. Compatible with proxy-unaware apps without configuration changes, ideal for security testing and traffic analysis.

repos.description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供免费HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4及SOCKS5代理列表，每5分钟自动抓取验证更新，覆盖105国家约3900个有效代理，支持TXT/JSON/CSV多格式，按协议分类且无重复。核心价值是实时可靠的代理资源池，适用于网页爬虫、数据采集、隐私保护及绕过地理限制等场景。技术亮点包括自动化验证、多协议支持、便捷下载及NPM模块集成。
repos.summary_en: The proxifly/free-proxy-list repository provides a free, frequently updated list of HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies, fetched and validated every 5 minutes from 105 countries with around 3900 working entries. Available in TXT, JSON, and CSV formats, categorized by protocol and country with no duplicates. Core value lies in delivering real-time, reliable proxy resources ideal for web scraping, data collection, anonymity, and bypassing restrictions. Technical highlights include automated validation, multi-protocol support, easy downloads, and NPM module integration.

repos.description: 🚀 Transparent proxy injector for Antigravity. Force SOCKS5/HTTP proxy without TUN mode on Windows. | 专为 Antigravity 打造的免 TUN 强制代理工具，支持 DLL 注入与进程流量劫持。
repos.summary_zh: Antigravity-Proxy 是专为 Google Antigravity AI 编辑器设计的 Windows 透明代理注入工具。通过 DLL 注入（version.dll 等）和 MinHook 钩子，精准劫持 language_server、node.exe 等进程的网络流量，强制走 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理，无需 Clash TUN 模式。核心价值在于进程级流量控制，避免全局代理影响本地开发，解决中国用户系统代理不生效痛点。支持详细日志诊断与 IP 出口检测，C++17 实现，部署简单。
repos.summary_en: Antigravity-Proxy is a Windows-specific transparent proxy injector tailored for Google's Antigravity AI-powered agentic IDE. It uses DLL injection (e.g., version.dll) and MinHook to hijack network traffic from Antigravity processes like language_server_windows_x64.exe and node.exe, forcing SOCKS5/HTTP proxy routing without TUN mode. This enables selective proxying for Chinese users facing system proxy bypass issues, avoiding global traffic impact. Features C++17 implementation, detailed logging, IP diagnostics for location restrictions, and easy deployment to the app directory.

repos.description: A high-performance ASCII video rendering engine featuring real-time WebSocket binary streaming and an isolated compiler for serverless static generation. Built for low-latency 30 FPS playback on HTML5 Canvas.
repos.summary_zh: ASCILINE是一款高性能跨平台实时ASCII视频渲染引擎，通过WebSocket二进制帧流传输至HTML5 Canvas，实现超低延迟30FPS播放。核心价值在于将视频像素映射为纯文本画布，支持实时CSS滤镜、低带宽零GPU运行及轻量LLM的AI语义处理。采用Python/FastAPI后端结合OpenCV和NumPy解码映射，支持多色彩模式、自适应编解码、音频同步、播放列表及YouTube/摄像头流。适用于低资源设备、交互式网页媒体交付和嵌入式场景，无需传统视频标签。
repos.summary_en: ASCILINE is a high-performance, cross-platform real-time ASCII video rendering engine that streams binary-encoded frames via WebSockets to HTML5 Canvas for ultra-low latency 30 FPS playback. It transforms video into pure typographic canvas content, enabling real-time CSS filters, low-bandwidth zero-GPU operation on constrained devices, and seamless integration with lightweight LLMs for AI processing. Python/FastAPI backend uses OpenCV and NumPy for decoding and mapping; vanilla JS frontend handles rendering. Supports multiple color modes, adaptive codecs, audio sync, playlists, YouTube, and webcam streaming. Ideal for interactive web media, embedded systems, and low-resource environments without video elements.

repos.summary_zh: 该插件将微信消息通道深度集成至Claude Code，开发者可直接在终端收发微信消息。采用本地MCP服务器与HTTP长轮询技术，无需公网Webhook。通过二维码登录和配对码验证实现安全认证，并针对微信API的context_token机制优化，支持双向消息同步，无缝衔接开发工作流。
repos.summary_en: This plugin deeply integrates WeChat messaging channels into Claude Code, allowing developers to send and receive WeChat messages directly in the terminal without switching contexts. It employs a local MCP server with HTTP long-polling technology, eliminating the need for public webhooks. Features include QR code login, pairing code verification, and optimized handling of WeChat's context_token mechanism for bidirectional message synchronization, seamlessly integrating into developer workflows.

repos.description: Open-source network quality monitoring platform with multi-node Ping, TCPing, HTTP, DNS, IPv6 and Traceroute testing.
repos.summary_zh: 开源多节点网络质量监控平台，支持Ping/TCPing/HTTP/DNS/Traceroute/IPv6探测。采用Master+Agent+RabbitMQ架构，基于RuoYi-Vue-Plus、Next.js与Prometheus Blackbox，提供Agent自动上下线、一键部署、IP地理解析及广告系统，助力企业低成本搭建网络运维与测速平台。
repos.summary_en: Open-source multi-node network quality monitoring platform supporting Ping, TCPing, HTTP, DNS, Traceroute and IPv6. Built with Master+Agent+RabbitMQ architecture using RuoYi-Vue-Plus, Next.js and Prometheus Blackbox. Features auto Agent management, one-click deployment, IP geolocation and ad system for low-cost enterprise network ops.

repos.description: Shadowfetch is a lightweight fetcher built with native TCP Sockets, for Cloudflare Workers.
repos.summary_zh: Shadowfetch 是 Cloudflare Workers 的隐私优先网络请求库，通过原生 TCP 套接字绕过内置 fetch 的元数据泄露问题。核心功能包括自动剥离 cf-ipcountry、cf-connecting-ip 等敏感头信息，确保用户 IP 与地理位置不被意外暴露。适用于需严格隐私保护的代理、镜像或数据转发场景，提供轻量级、可控的请求控制能力。
repos.summary_en: Shadowfetch is a privacy-focused fetcher for Cloudflare Workers that leverages native TCP sockets to prevent metadata leakage from built-in fetch. It sanitizes sensitive headers like cf-ipcountry and cf-connecting-ip, ensuring user IP and geolocation remain hidden. Ideal for privacy-sensitive proxying, mirroring, and data forwarding with minimal overhead and maximum control.

repos.description: 利用Deno提供的服务进行代理中转
repos.summary_zh: DenoProxy是基于Deno运行时构建的轻量级动态代理服务，核心能力在于通过URL参数实时配置代理目标，并将/proxy路径请求无缝转发至指定后端。项目采用Deno原生HTTP服务器与KV存储，支持本地运行与Deno Deploy云部署双模式，适用于API调试、跨域请求代理及开发环境网络中转等场景，具备配置灵活、部署极简的技术特征。
repos.summary_en: DenoProxy is a lightweight dynamic proxy service built on Deno runtime, featuring real-time target configuration via URL parameters and seamless request forwarding for /proxy paths. Leveraging Deno's native HTTP server and KV storage, it supports both local execution and Deno Deploy cloud deployment. Ideal for API debugging, cross-origin request proxying, and development environment network tunneling, it delivers flexible configuration and minimal deployment overhead.
